topic: User Research and Understanding User Needs
learningObjectives: Identify suitable user research methods for different design problems.
Distinguish qualitative and quantitative research data.
Create basic user insights from research findings.

activities.title: Research Method Selector
activities.instruction: Choose the best research method for each scenario.

content.concept: Interviews, surveys, observation, usability testing, and analytics answer different types of research questions.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Qualitative vs Quantitative
activities.instruction: Sort each research finding into the correct category.

content.concept: Qualitative research explores behaviors and motivations, while quantitative research measures patterns using numerical data.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Interview Flow Builder
activities.instruction: Arrange the stages of a user interview.

content.concept: Effective interviews use clear goals, open-ended questions, active listening, and structured synthesis.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Insight Extraction Lab
activities.instruction: Select the strongest insight from each observation.

content.concept: A useful UX insight connects observed user behavior with an underlying need, frustration, or motivation.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.
